evidence_snippets: Benefits The canvas view offers the following benefits: Improved responsiveness of the canvas interaction: With the canvas view, you can smoothly move tasks and triggers, making it easier to create complex workflows.

Hotkeys The following hotkeys are available in the canvas view: Key Function Ctrl + C Copy Ctrl + V Paste Ctrl + Z Undo Shift + Ctrl + Z Redo Delete Delete selected element What's next Learn about the Integration editor layout .
